description: Searches whogothacked.com's record for organizations by name or domain. Returns each match with its slug, incident count, the date its latest incident was first on record, the tier of that incident and source links. Records are verified from regulator filings and Have I Been Pwned; a threat actor's claim is never a source. A miss means there is no record here, not that no breach happened. Counts from different sources are not additive.
name: search_breaches
title: Search breach records
